title_en: Methods and Mechanisms of Discourse with the Other
description_en: From the meeting of His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari (may his shadow endure), with a female delegation from the seminaries (hawza) in Hijaz.
summary: Religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari discusses the proper methodologies and ethical mechanisms for engaging in dialogue with ideological and religious opponents, addressing a visiting seminary delegation.
